customManagers.description: Codex release tags are rust-v<ver>; prerelease tags (rust-v0.162.0-alpha.1) never match. This bumps components/codex/version only: build/codex-revision, the commit of that tag, is not derivable from the version.
The Rust toolchain pin: a Mavergreen/rust release tag, bare.
The clang-22 pin: a Mavergreen/clang-22 release tag, bare.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/codex/version but cannot derive the tag's commit, so build/codex-revision stays on the old commit and release.yml's upstream-pin check fails the PR (it names the commit to use). Not an automerge exception: automerge stays on, and the failing check is what holds the PR until a human edits build/codex-revision.
prBodyNotes: Renovate bumped `components/codex/version` only. Update `build/codex-revision` to the commit of this release's `rust-v<version>` tag on this branch (the failing `check-upstream-pin` step prints it), and refresh `patches/` if they no longer apply. See INGREDIENTS.md "Releasing".
